findings.detail: RESOLVED. Q4's earlier limit — no user-facing outcome verified in the running app — is now closed. Acceptance for #5 was observed in a real browser against the delivered revision 1f22d77: the just-created request stayed visible, was marked Not listed yet while the list lagged, and became an ordinary single row once confirmed. Root cause was measured, not guessed: GitHub's list endpoint is served from an intermittently lagging replica while direct issue reads are immediate.

RESOLVED. The reconciliation contract is covered deterministically by 8 new cases (72 tests total) and recorded in the behaviour spec alongside the status contract, which AGENTS.md requires to move with its fixtures.

RESOLVED. The gap between GitHub's eventual-consistent list and the app's truthful-display constraint is now a documented behaviour contract with an explicit home, rather than an emergent accident of view code.

NEW TARGET WORK, filed not fixed. The list blanks briefly on each ~30s background refresh because the list effect clears items before every load, losing scroll position and briefly showing an empty list even when a read fails. Found in the browser during #5 verification; admitted queued as its own outcome so #5's scope stayed single. Classification: ordinary target work, not an adoption or contract defect.

Everything else in this cycle was verified, but this gap is the one that only a new session can close.

STANDING DEVIATION, unchanged. Closed fixtures #2 and #3 retain yolo:state:* labels, so check.py keeps reporting issue_state: conflicting and flags the checkpoint as having unresolved findings. Retained because the labels are the live evidence docs/verification.md cites; repairing by deletion would destroy the trail. The maintainer has still not ruled on this.

Congruent. The outcome was admitted by the agent within its own grant, judged routine implementation with no reserved decision; no charter or authority edit was made; every created artifact carries the agreed yolo watermark; the changelog entry was recorded against the source issue.

AGENT PROCESS DEVIATION, self-reported and retained. PR #23 (this review) was merged while its required check 'Test and type check' was still pending, which the adopted protocol forbids: required evidence must pass on the current subject before a dependent merge. Cause: the agent waited for SUCCESS in a poll loop but merged on the iteration where the loop's own output still read pending. Impact: none to the delivered content — the check passed on the identical PR head 004d30f6 and the main-branch run passed on b4d07db7, so the merged content is verified — but the merge decision was made on unverified evidence, which is exactly the behaviour the delivery contract exists to prevent. Remedy: record the correct wait-and-recheck behaviour for the merge step; the two earlier merges in this cycle did wait, and this one did not.
